This is island life.

Off the coast of southern Mozambique, within the Bazaruto Archipelago National Park, lies &Beyond Benguerra Island Lodge. Sheltered by indigenous forest, framed by sweeping beaches and opening onto a protected channel, it’s a place where marine adventure, quiet retreat and warm Mozambican hospitality come together with effortless ease. —
The kind of island that changes your pace and perspective.

about/.alt: Luxury Solo Trip at andBeyond Benguerra Island

about/.text: Benguerra is the second largest island in the Bazaruto Archipelago, a place of shifting sand dunes, freshwater lakes and vibrant communities where island traditions endure. Here, daily life is guided by ways passed down over generations, shaped by customs that continue to define the island’s spirit. —

about/.alt: Coffee Table at Benguerra Island in Mozambique
Green Couch in andBeyond Benguerra Island Guest lounge

about/.text: Benguerra Island lies within the protected Bazaruto Archipelago National Park, home to one of the Indian Ocean’s most remarkable marine ecosystems. These waters support a rich diversity of marine life, from reef fish and dolphins to the rare dugong still found grazing on seagrass beds. Through marine conservation initiatives and local community partnerships, every stay helps protect the reefs, wildlife and island livelihoods that sustain this extraordinary place. —
Leaving our oceans a better place

From the dhow bar to the PADI dive centre, Benguerra Island’s thoughtfully designed spaces invite both connection and pause. Sip a signature cocktail as traditional dhows drift across the horizon, revisit the day’s adventures in the library, browse the Beach Shop or explore the world below the surface with expert guides. For a slower moment shaped by local tradition, settle in for a game of Mbao.

about/.text: Meals reflect the flavours of the Mozambican coastline: fresh seafood, vibrant produce and spices that speak of the region’s rich trading history. Dine beside the ocean, beneath the trees or in the privacy of your room. The experience is relaxed, generous and shaped around your favourites.

Set in tranquil forest surrounds, the lodge’s massage sala offers a quiet invitation to slow down. Choose from a curated menu of wellness treatments and restorative experiences, from massage to meditation, all designed to create place of rest and renewal.

Children of all ages are welcome at Benguerra Island, where spacious accommodation, a relaxed private and lodge swimming pool and family-friendly experiences on land and at sea make it easy for families to spend meaningful time together.

accommodation/.text: Thirteen spacious rooms are tucked between indigenous forest and soft white sand, each designed around the ease of island life. Open living spaces, shaded verandas and private plunge pools create a stay that feels deeply comfortable and closely connected to the natural world.
Every room looks towards the Indian Ocean, where shifting light and open views shape the day. Wake to the sound of the waves, step into the morning air, and settle into island life at your own pace.

Shaded salas, hanging daybeds and private pools create space to pause between beach, sea and reef. Each room is designed for comfort that feels unhurried, generous and deeply connected to its surroundings.

Your room’s personal bar is tailored to your preferences and refreshed throughout your stay, while coffee and tea are always within reach. It’s a quiet layer of comfort that makes each day feel effortless.

experiences/.text: Uncover every adventure
More than what you see or do.

On Benguerra Island, adventure arrives in many forms. Some days invite exploration – diving vibrant reefs or climbing sun-washed dunes. Others ask nothing more than a quiet swim and a moment to watch the tide shift across the sand. The beauty lies in choosing what feels right. —
A day at Benguerra Island

experiences/.alt: Africa Mozambique Benguerra Island Dylan Royal

experiences/.text: On the island.
Beyond the shoreline lies a landscape shaped by wind, water and time.
Island expedition : Venture beyond the beach to discover freshwater lakes, soaring dunes and quiet villages to experience the warmth of Benguerra’s people and everyday island life.
Horseback riding : Explore Benguerra Island on horseback, following open beaches and inland paths with rides tailored to your pace and experience.
Birdwatching: From protected indigenous forest to inland lakes, Benguerra Island offers rewarding sightings for keen birders and nature lovers alike.
Community visit: Spend time with local residents and gain a deeper understanding of the traditions, livelihoods and warmth that shape island life on Benguerra.
Swimming with horses.

For a truly unforgettable island adventure, ride bareback into the turquoise waters that surround Benguerra. Riding bareback into the clear waters of the Indian Ocean, you’ll discover a rare sense of freedom, with your horse moving easily through the sea beside you. Guided by experienced handlers and suitable for a range of riding levels, this is a joyful, unforgettable encounter shaped by the spirit of the island.
Find out more
In the water.
The surrounding marine reserve offers extraordinary encounters with the Indian Ocean’s vibrant life.
Snorkelling : Drift above colourful reefs just offshore, where clear water and abundant marine life make every outing feel like discovery.
Sea kayaking and stand-up paddle boarding: Glide across calm turquoise waters at your own pace, taking in the island’s beauty from a quieter perspective.
Dhow cruise : Sail across the bay on a traditional dhow and watch the shifting light transform Benguerra island and its surrounding waters.
Deep-sea fishing*: Head further offshore in search of prized game fish, where Benguerra Island’s deep channels and ocean currents promise thrilling encounters.
Whale watching*: From June to December, head out by boat for the chance to witness migrating whales in the waters surrounding the archipelago.
*At an additional cost

experiences/.text: Diving beneath the surface.

For those drawn below the ocean’s surface, the lodge’s fully equipped PADI dive centre offers a natural starting point. With experienced guides, tailored dive experiences* and access to the archipelago’s coral-rich reefs, it brings Benguerra Island’s underwater world within easy reach. From first-time dives to more advanced underwater exploration, each experience is led by expert guides and shaped around your confidence, curiosity and sense of adventure.
*At an additional cost
Find out more
More to discover.
From wellness and scenic flights to celebrations by the sea, discover experiences that add even more meaning to your stay.
Castaway picnic : Slip away to a secluded stretch of shoreline for a private picnic in one of the archipelago’s most peaceful and beautiful settings.
Wellness treatments*: Unwind with a personalised wellness treatment in a tranquil forest setting, where the sound of the ocean deepens every moment of relaxation.
Scenic helicopter flights *: Take to the skies for a striking aerial view of the Bazaruto Archipelago, with its sandbanks, islands and clear blue waters laid out below.
*At an additional cost
